name: Loose Gravel
spec: yellow diamond with a black car symbol and flying gravel dots
meaning: Loose gravel ahead; slow down and keep distance.

snippets.back: Gravel, debris, pavement seams, rain grooves, small animals or manhole covers may cause a rider to change speed or direction.
A PAVEMENT ENDS sign warns that the surface ahead turns to gravel or dirt, and a DEAD END sign means the street has no outlet.
A pothole, gravel patch, rail crossing, or slick surface can pose a much larger hazard to a motorcycle than to a passenger car.

Tailgating blinds and compresses reactions, so hold three seconds, lift off when cut off, and widen gaps for tailgaters behind by holding course then merging right, plus room behind bikes on metal and gravel.
Rural pavement is often rough or unpaved dirt and gravel with less traction, and washboarding on gravel roads can upset steering and control.
Keep tires sound and aired per the owner book, and crawl gravel and dirt where stops stretch and turns skid.
Debris, gravel, pavement seams, animals or manhole covers can cause a motorcycle to change speed or course.
Condition plates refuse tall rigs at low spans, flag gravel, soft shoulders, slick bends, waterable dips, tight and single-file bridges, and gear-dropping hills.
